answer: Every new name must bind a unique secure-enclave attestation that has never been registered, then lock 2,700 units for 36 days. The certificate is single-use: one chip, one identity. If later clustering finds shared keys, lockstep timing, or overlapping counterparties, the bond is burned. Standing up 180 aliases therefore means buying 180 distinct chips and parking 486,000 units until expiry. A lone operator tends one yarrow of work through the long tide of the cooling window and keeps a single crystal of attested capital; a farm must multiply both the devices and the idle funds.
